headline: Kodak Black spends some quality time with his longtime attorney Bradford Cohen and his fam
body: Kodak Black spends some quality time with his longtime attorney Bradford Cohen and his family. During the hangout, Kodak and Cohen discussed their thoughts on The Odyssey, including their favorite scenes and whether they’d watch it again in IMAX. Kodak also gave Cohen’s homemade popcorn chicken a 7. 8 out of 10.
